'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Dave McCord DS Let Them Make The First Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Dave McCord]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Let Them Make The First Move / At Peace|Let Them Make The First Move / At Peace (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
